title: Mod API: the example mod sees DPC (queries, events, claims, overrides, a broken mod)
intro: Needs DPC_API_Example.lua in autorun (it is). Start as the Arisen. Press End to start; this one mostly runs itself.

steps.text: Taking over the main pawn (watch for possess and transition events).
The example mod now claims the camera transition. Back to the Arisen: there should be NO camera transition.
steps.each_frame: if not G_api1 then G_api1 = true; _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_claim('camera.transition', true) end

steps.text: Claim given back, and slow motion overridden to off for this session. Taking over: transition again but at full speed.
steps.each_frame: if not G_api2 then G_api2 = true; _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_claim('camera.transition', false); _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_override('switch_cine_slowmo', 1.0) end

steps.text: Override cleared. A broken handler is added: switching back and forth 6 times; DPC should switch it off after 5 errors (a note appears).
steps.each_frame:
if not G_api3 then G_api3 = { n = 0, t = 0 }; _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_override('switch_cine_slowmo', nil); _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_bad(true) end
local now = os.clock()
if G_api3.n < 12 and now > G_api3.t then G_api3.t = now + 0.9; G_api3.n = G_api3.n + 1
  local d = _G.DPC_dbg
  json.dump_file('DPC_cmd.json', { id = 'api1_' .. G_api3.n .. '_' .. math.floor(now * 1000), cmd = (G_api3.n % 2 == 1) and 'release' or 'possess', idx = 0 })
end

steps.text: Done. Check DPC's settings > Connected mods: dpc_api_example_bad should show OFF (errors). Back to the Arisen.
steps.each_frame: if not G_api4 then G_api4 = true; _G.DPC_API_EXAMPLE.set_bad(false) end
